parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: to undo all the tight knots,
we had to light a match
to remove it from the parcel.
and now her feet were sore
When ice melts, we get water.
it was just a small dot
on the side of the mountain.

parts.text: As it was impossible to undo all the tight knots, we had to light a match and burn the coarse string to remove it from the parcel. Jane earnestly regretted not having hired a car to do the Christmas shopping. She had walked everywhere, and now her feet were sore where her new shoes had been rubbing. When ice melts, we get water. Beyond the town, they could see the house they had chosen to rent. From that distance, it was just a small dot on the side of the mountain.
